Description.description: AI analysis playbook definitions in Spaarke. When users ask about 'playbooks', 'analysis tools', 'AI capabilities', or 'what can you analyze', query this table. Playbooks are reusable multi-step AI analysis workflows such as Lease Review, Risk Scan, NDA Analysis, and Contract Review. They have a name, description, category, applicable document types, and can be public or private.
